children: CVRx has named John Landry, currently Chief Financial Officer at Nyxoah, to be its next CFO.
Landry will succeed Jared Oasheim and join the Minneapolis-based medical-device company on Oct. 12, CVRx said Monday.

He joined Nyxoah, a Belgian medical-technology company, in November 2024 as chief financial officer. Before that, he spent 12 years at Vapotherm, where he was finance chief and led the company's initial public offering.
Nyxoah said Loïc Moreau, who was a former chief financial officer and currently serves as president international, will fill in on an interim basis. Landry plans to depart on Oct. 2.
Moreau joined Nyxoah in 2022 as finance chief before transitioning to his current role. He previously held senior roles at GSK.
Separately, Nyxoah reaffirmed its annual financial guidance.
